title: Who is Joe Petraro-Hyppolite the 13-year-old boy with 168 IQ?
summary_full: At just 13, Joe Petraro-Hyppolite from Long Island is defying age expectations as he embarks on a master's program at New York University. He notably graduated high school at 11 and scored an impressive 1590 on the SAT by age 10. Joe is diving into disciplines such as sports management, kinesiology, and biology, aiming to complete his undergraduate degree next Spring, solidifying his place among exceptional academic achievers.
